title: Mormon and the Record
summary: Mormon describes handing the record to his son Moroni, having witnessed nearly all the destruction of the Nephites, and hopes Moroni will survive to write about them and Christ.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon is about to deliver his record into the hands of his son Moroni.
Mormon has witnessed almost all the destruction of the Nephites.
Mormon says it is many hundred years after Christ's coming as he delivers the records, and hopes Moroni will survive to write concerning the Nephites and Christ.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon and Moroni may be shown together with a record being handed over.
unspecified_visual_details: Their ages and appearances, the record's material and form, and the specific location are unstated.

narration.text: I, Mormon, being about to deliver up the record
may God grant that he may survive them

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Mormon describes his own perspective and expresses a hope for Moroni; this does not narrate the Nephites' destruction as a present scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the destruction of the Nephites here.

title: Mormon Finds the Plates
summary: Mormon recounts abridging the plates of Nephi through King Benjamin's reign, searching records entrusted to him, and finding plates containing an account from Jacob to King Benjamin and words of Nephi. He values their prophecies of Christ.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon made an abridgment from the plates of Nephi down to King Benjamin's reign.
Mormon searched records delivered into his hands and found plates containing an account from Jacob to King Benjamin and many words of Nephi.
Mormon says the plates pleased him because of prophecies of Christ and that many prophecies had been fulfilled.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon may be shown examining plates or records.
unspecified_visual_details: The plates, records, and setting are not visually described.

narration.text: I searched among the records which had been delivered into my hands
I found these plates
the prophecies of the coming of Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Mormon's account of searching and finding is retrospective.
prohibited_inventions: Do not portray Christ or the fulfillment of prophecies as visible events in this scene.

title: Choosing the Plates
summary: Mormon chooses material from the plates to finish his record, saying he cannot write a hundredth part of his people's history, and plans to include these plates with the remainder of his record.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon chose the material on these plates to finish his record and says he will take the remainder from the plates of Nephi.
Mormon says he cannot write a hundredth part of the things of his people.
Mormon plans to put these plates with the remainder of his record, calling them choice to him and his brethren.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon may be shown selecting or arranging records.
unspecified_visual_details: The arrangement and physical appearance of the records are unstated.

narration.text: I chose these things, to finish my record upon them
I cannot write the hundredth part of the things of my people.
put them with the remainder of my record

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict additional episodes from the people's history.

title: A Wise Purpose
summary: Mormon says he acts for a wise purpose according to the Spirit of the Lord, acknowledges that the Lord knows what is to come, and prays for his people to know God and Christ's redemption again.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon says his action is for a wise purpose, as prompted according to the workings of the Spirit of the Lord in him.
Mormon says he does not know all things, but the Lord knows all things to come and works in him according to the Lord's will.
Mormon's prayer concerns his brethren and their return to knowledge of God and Christ's redemption.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon may be shown in prayer or reflection.
unspecified_visual_details: No visible form of the Spirit or the Lord is described.

narration.text: I do not know all things
the Lord knoweth all things which are to come
my prayer to God is concerning my brethren

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Spirit's prompting and the Lord's work are described in narration, not as visible appearances.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a visible divine figure or supernatural manifestation.

title: Finishing the Record
summary: Mormon proceeds to finish his record from the plates of Nephi according to the knowledge and understanding God has given him.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon proceeds to finish his record, taking it from the plates of Nephi and using the knowledge and understanding God gave him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon may be shown writing or working with records.
unspecified_visual_details: The writing materials, record form, and setting are unstated.

narration.text: I, Mormon, proceed to finish out my record
according to the knowledge and the understanding which God has given me.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict God appearing or speaking directly.

title: Amaleki Gives the Plates to Benjamin
summary: Mormon recounts that Amaleki delivered the plates to King Benjamin, who placed them with other records handed down by generations of kings.

explicit_facts.text: After Amaleki delivered the plates into King Benjamin's hands, Benjamin took them and placed them with other plates containing records handed down by kings.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Amaleki handing plates to King Benjamin and Benjamin placing them with other plates are drawable actions.
unspecified_visual_details: The place, appearances, and exact design of the plates are unstated.

narration.text: Amaleki had delivered up these plates into the hands of king Benjamin
he took them and put them with the other plates

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a past event reported by Mormon, not a present-time encounter.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add dialogue or details about the handover.

title: Records Passed to Mormon
summary: Mormon says the records passed down from King Benjamin through generations and eventually came into his hands. He prays they will be preserved and says they will be used in judgment at the last day.

explicit_facts.text: The records were handed down from King Benjamin through generations until they came into Mormon's hands.
Mormon prays that the records will be preserved and says he knows they will be preserved.
Mormon says the records contain great things and that his people and their brethren will be judged by them at the great and last day, according to God's word.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon may be shown holding or guarding records.
unspecified_visual_details: No scene of the future judgment or its participants is described.

narration.text: they have fallen into my hands
I, Mormon, pray to God that they may be preserved

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The last-day judgment is reported as future, not depicted as a present visual event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the great and last day or a judgment scene.

title: Contentions Among King Benjamin's People
summary: Mormon reports that King Benjamin had some contentions among his own people.

explicit_facts.text: King Benjamin had somewhat of contentions among his own people.

unspecified_visual_details: The people involved, location, and form of the contentions are not specified.

narration.text: And now, concerning this king Benjamin—he had somewhat of contentions among his own people.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Mormon reports the contentions; the verse does not depict a specific incident or place Mormon or King Benjamin visibly at one.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a specific argument, participants, confrontation, or visible appearance for Mormon or King Benjamin.

title: The Lamanite Armies Attack
summary: Lamanite armies come down from the land of Nephi to battle Benjamin's people. King Benjamin gathers his armies, stands against them, and fights with the sword of Laban.

explicit_facts.text: The Lamanite armies came down out of the land of Nephi to battle Benjamin's people.
King Benjamin gathered his armies, stood against the Lamanites, and fought with the sword of Laban.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The armies may be shown facing one another as battle begins.
unspecified_visual_details: The battlefield, army size, clothing, and appearance of the sword are unstated.

narration.text: the armies of the Lamanites came down out of the land of Nephi
king Benjamin gathered together his armies
with the sword of Laban.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse explicitly describes military action.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add tactics, individual combatants, injuries, or gore.

title: The Lamanites Are Driven Out
summary: Benjamin's people contend against their enemies in the strength of the Lord, slay many thousands of Lamanites, and drive the Lamanites out of all the lands of their inheritance.

explicit_facts.text: Benjamin's people contend against their enemies in the strength of the Lord and slay many thousands of Lamanites.
They continue contending until they drive the Lamanites out of all the lands of their inheritance.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The armies may be shown driving the Lamanites away from the lands.
unspecified_visual_details: The exact battlefield and military formations are unstated.

narration.text: they did contend against their enemies
they had driven them out of all the lands of their inheritance.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse reports casualties but does not describe their visual details.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show gore, wounds, or severed body parts.

title: False Christs Punished
summary: Mormon reports that false Christs had appeared, their mouths had been shut, and they were punished according to their crimes.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon reports that there had been false Christs, that their mouths had been shut, and that they were punished according to their crimes.

unspecified_visual_details: The people, means of silencing, punishment, and location are not specified.

narration.text: there had been false Christs
they punished according to their crimes;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse summarizes past events; it does not identify or depict a particular person or incident.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent identities, teachings, a silencing method, or a punishment scene.

title: Contention and Dissensions
summary: Mormon reports false prophets, preachers, and teachers among the people, punished according to their crimes, and much contention and many dissensions away unto the Lamanites.

explicit_facts.text: There had been false prophets, preachers, and teachers among the people, and all were punished according to their crimes.
There had been much contention and many dissensions away unto the Lamanites.

unspecified_visual_details: The individuals, punishments, and circumstances of the dissensions are not specified.

narration.text: there had been false prophets, and false preachers and teachers among the people
much contention and many dissensions away unto the Lamanites

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The events are summarized retrospectively; no particular punishment or dissension is narrated.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage an invented sermon, argument, conversion, or punishment.

title: Benjamin and the Prophets
summary: Mormon describes King Benjamin as a holy and righteous ruler. Holy men in the land speak God's word with power and authority, using sharpness because of the people's stiffneckedness.

explicit_facts.text: King Benjamin was a holy man and reigned over his people in righteousness.
Many holy men in the land spoke the word of God with power and authority, using much sharpness because of the people's stiffneckedness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Holy men may be shown speaking to people, without inventing the content of their words.
unspecified_visual_details: The speakers, audience, specific teachings, and setting are not otherwise described.

narration.text: he did reign over his people in righteousness
they did speak the word of God with power and with authority

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse summarizes the holy men's preaching and does not supply a speech to quote.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent sermon dialogue or specific audience reactions.

title: Peace Established
summary: With help from the holy men and prophets, King Benjamin labors with all his might and the prophets also labor, and peace is established again in the land.

explicit_facts.text: With help from the holy men, King Benjamin labored with all his might, along with the prophets, and established peace in the land once more.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Benjamin and the prophets may be shown laboring together; the result is peace in the land.
unspecified_visual_details: The form of their labor, the means of establishing peace, and the setting are not specified.

narration.text: king Benjamin, by laboring with all the might of his body
did once more establish peace in the land.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse summarizes the work and its result without specifying individual actions.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a treaty, assembly, or specific reconciliation.
